design_description: The Swing First jersey uses an aggressive neon lime and black identity, built around movement, impact and a deliberately unconventional street-sport aesthetic. The main body is electric lime, covered by an all-over pattern of interlocking jagged, angular strokes in a darker green. The shapes overlap in multiple directions, creating a sense of speed and controlled chaos while remaining tonal enough for the crest and branding to stay visible. Large black side panels rise diagonally from the hem toward the underarms, giving the torso a sharper athletic silhouette. Black is repeated on the collar and cuffs, providing a strong frame against the fluorescent base. One of the most distinctive details is the barbed-wire graphic running along the shoulder and upper-sleeve seams. It introduces a rebellious, slightly underground character that works naturally with the sharp pattern and the team's Swing First identity. The monochrome black-and-silver shield crest sits prominently on the chest, with understated black Momuto branding opposite. A small SWING FIRST hem tag adds another bespoke team detail without competing with the main graphic. Overall, it is a high-energy, disruptive and instantly recognizable design: fluorescent lime for visibility, black for aggression, angular graphics for motion and barbed-wire detailing to give Swing First its own raw visual personality.
